summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullish bets on the S&P 500, evidenced by massive premium accumulation in SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes expiring in 2026. While QQQ shows heavy put buying ($540.7M), the dominant conviction lies in massive, multi-day persistent accumulations of SPX 7000C contracts (e.g., $2.2B in the 2026-12-18 expiry) and SPX 6000C contracts (e.g., $2.3B in the 2026-09-18 expiry). Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the broad market, but monitor for volatility spikes in tech (QQQ/MSFT) given the heavy put/call imbalance in QQQ (P/C 2.86) and extreme call dominance in MSFT (P/C 0.12).
